Name: Ayeisha - The Postal Worker (Custom NPC)
Author: TheLimeyDragon
Description:
[center][img]https://web.archive.org/web/20230727161219im_/https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/692470297248399401/737467822573355059/unknown.png[/img]﻿[/center]
Ayeisha is a custom NPC who works for the Ferngill Postal Service.  I still regard this as an early version of her and is not yet complete. (I just slowly work on it when I can)

There are currently a number of mail delivery events for the vanilla characters in Stardew.
There is also  additional events for the some custom NPCs:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5295]Mister Ginger[/url][/*]
[*]Jacob, Eloise and a Duck from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8606]Juna[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10950]Jorts and Jean[/url][/*]
[*]Kyle from the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14510]Ornithologist Guild[/url][/*]
[*]Susan from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url] or the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45990]standalone[/url] version[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38008]Tilly[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38698]Pelican Town Municipal[/url][/*]
[*]Spork from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23979]Law and Order[/url][/*]
[*]Jack the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42877]Friendly Snowman[/url][/*]
[/list][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24852]Coal Point Farm[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12079]Defense Division[/url] also have their own crossover events with her (but they are part of their mods)

One Trash bear related event if you have got to year 3.

There is also a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside[/url] related quest.

There are also "Love Token" events where NPCs you are dating will send a special deliver to you.. This supports the vanilla NPCs and 50+ other custom NPCs. This can also be disabled if desired.

The amount of dialogue at the moment is not as fully fleshed out yet as I would like. Future updates will improve on that.

The mod does modify some maps very slightly, it adds mailboxes to NPCs that do not have them currently.

There are some tile changes which will stand out with texture mods. I have added some basic compatibility with the following, to make them fit in.

[list]
[*]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour by DaisyNiko[/*]

[*]﻿Starblue Valley World Recolor by Lita[/*]

[*]Flower Valley by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/48693548]Jina2ya[/url]﻿ (who kindly helped with the flower valley version of the van)[/*]
[*]﻿﻿Vibrant Pastoral by GrapePonta[/*]
[*]Way Back Pelican Town by﻿ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/51171631]Gweniaczek[/url]﻿  (who kindly helped with the way back  mail slots)[/*]

[*]Yet Another Recolour by Narianka[/*]
[*]Gloomy Recolor by KittenTyme[/*]
[*]Elle's Buildings by Elle [/*]

[*]Cotton Candy by PinkStations[/*]

[/list]As long as a map hasn't been altered in ways that block her, she should work fine with most mods, although she maybe checking thin air if a mod has overwritten a custom mailbox. :P

The base design of her portrait was designed by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/74479268]fellowclown[/url]. Then it was modified/altered by me  with my limited art skills to get the other needed emotions. (Hat was also altered by me slightly.)

There is also now an alternative portrait design as an optional download. Designed by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/70148453]AirynS.[/url]

[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26118]kTT Portraits[/url]﻿﻿ by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/K1nTT/]K1nTT[/url]﻿[/*]

The mod also adds a -tiny- map, walking east of the BusStop Road which contains her van, which she ends her day on.

She also has a randomised schedule and will visit locations in the following mods (if they are installed):

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿ or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45990]Susan[/url] (standalone version)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url]﻿[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32872]Downhill Project[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16422]The Stray Catfe[/url]
﻿[/*]
[/list]I have included a basic schedule maker which you can use to create your own schedule for her if you want her to visit a custom NPC that she currently doesn't.
